Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
# R-hub's generic GitHub Actions workflow file. It's canonical location is at
# https://github.com/r-hub/actions/blob/v1/workflows/rhub.yaml
# You can update this file to a newer version using the rhub2 package:
#
# rhub::rhub_setup()
#
# It is unlikely that you need to modify this file manually.

name: R-hub
run-name: "${{ github.event.inputs.id }}: ${{ github.event.inputs.name || format('Manually run by {0}', github.triggering_actor) }}"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      config:
        description: 'A comma separated list of R-hub platforms to use.'
        type: string
        default: 'linux,windows,macos,m1-san,clang-asan,clang-ubsan,gcc-asan,rchk,valgrind'
            # 'clang16,clang17,clang18,clang19,clang20,clang21,clang22,gcc13,gcc14,gcc15,gcc16'
            # from rhub::rhub_platforms()
      name:
        description: 'Run name. You can leave this empty now.'
        type: string
      id:
        description: 'Unique ID. You can leave this empty now.'
        type: string

jobs:

  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      containers: ${{ steps.rhub-setup.outputs.containers }}
      platforms: ${{ steps.rhub-setup.outputs.platforms }}

    steps:
    # NO NEED TO CHECKOUT HERE
    - uses: r-hub/actions/setup@v1
      with:
        config: ${{ github.event.inputs.config }}
      id: rhub-setup

  linux-containers:
    needs: setup
    if: ${{ needs.setup.outputs.containers != '[]' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: ${{ matrix.config.label }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        config: ${{ fromJson(needs.setup.outputs.containers) }}
    container:
      image: ${{ matrix.config.container }}

    steps:
      - uses: r-hub/actions/checkout@v1
      - uses: r-hub/actions/platform-info@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.RHUB_TOKEN }}
          job-config: ${{ matrix.config.job-config }}
      - uses: r-hub/actions/setup-deps@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.RHUB_TOKEN }}
          job-config: ${{ matrix.config.job-config }}
      - uses: r-hub/actions/run-check@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.RHUB_TOKEN }}
          job-config: ${{ matrix.config.job-config }}

  other-platforms:
    needs: setup
    if: ${{ needs.setup.outputs.platforms != '[]' }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.config.os }}
    name: ${{ matrix.config.label }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        config: ${{ fromJson(needs.setup.outputs.platforms) }}

    steps:
      - uses: r-hub/actions/checkout@v1
      - uses: r-hub/actions/setup-r@v1
        with:
          job-config: ${{ matrix.config.job-config }}
          token: ${{ secrets.RHUB_TOKEN }}
      - uses: r-hub/actions/platform-info@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.RHUB_TOKEN }}
          job-config: ${{ matrix.config.job-config }}
      - uses: r-hub/actions/setup-deps@v1
        with:
          job-config: ${{ matrix.config.job-config }}
          token: ${{ secrets.RHUB_TOKEN }}
      - uses: r-hub/actions/run-check@v1
        with:
          job-config: ${{ matrix.config.job-config }}
          token: ${{ secrets.RHUB_TOKEN }}

results.content:
Pause repeatedly failing scheduled workflows

Pattern: P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE (failing_schedule_suppression)

When is pause repeatedly failing scheduled workflows applicable?

Assess pause repeatedly failing scheduled workflows for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: A monitored pause/resume policy is approved

Contraindications: Continuous monitoring or periodic checks are mandatory

Method: Notify the owner when pausing; Define an explicit recovery and reactivation path

Reported finding: Failure-streak suppression offers estimated savings.

Reported metrics: {"consecutive_failure_threshold": 3, "paid_total_vm_time_reduction_percent": 3.2}

Source: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions (2024), 4.3.1; Tables 5-6; PDF pp. 8, 9: https://software-lab.org/publications/icse2024_workflows.pdf

Literature example before:

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
keep running a repeatedly failing scheduled workflow


Literature example after:

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
pause after an approved failure streak and notify the owner
